answer: The gale of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Every claim climbs the ferrous of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the tide re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
